Implemented explicit optional source-column run retention alongside selected fixed-effects outputs. Default off; readouts reuse each run's existing QR and response coordinates; no additional response reads or run uncertainty maps. Results carry original IDs, run-local axes, voxel identities and statuses, including primary exclusions. Shared OLS and pooling-only APIs refuse incompatible retention. Pooled values, uncertainty and full joint precision remain unchanged. Corrected the independently reproduced loss of hrfScale during run-axis lowering (divisor 3 became 1 before the fix).

Exact candidate: fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc + patch e47e937d3d2bd45d57c86fd06fe0fba6cd7c8a8191513dd42370593bcff6bb37. Twelve reserved native files synchronized after checking their recorded original hashes. No unrelated native changes or historical benchmark inputs changed; uncommitted local evidence, no publication.

Evidence: design 258/258; full fit 282 JVM/273 JS before final test-only extensions; final retained-output/compiled-guide suites 15/15, model 28/28, firstLevelLaws 32/32. Tests cover independent R values, exact primary uncertainty invariance, FIR/gapped scans, requested backend product shapes, exclusions, cancellation and fail-closed API composition. Eight extracted snippets and four local rendered pages reviewed. All 51 PLS Neuro headless probes/108 required PASS records pass with unchanged execution-time source snapshots and no owned descendants, in 193.62 seconds including build. Public retained-run R difference <=8.89e-16; BIDS condition/FIR retention, identities, bounded reads and revision/cancellation failures pass. Final contract-note-only update preserves all executable fields and 301 other acceptance source inputs.

Durable receipt: docs/verification/run-coefficient-retention-2026-09-08.json.gz, SHA-256 1e7319b825530bca5322f84954387d14481cd0443a0a947bfebf5184989c4dfa, byte-identical to the home app receipt. It retains the reproduced metadata failure, development failures, exact sources, native/consumer logs, guide preview and synchronization. Consumer admission is home issue bd-01M20A5F8GRXHXRJFRZR9BH634 in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro. UI, durable outputs, bounded trace inspection and PLS handoff remain separate open work; no new throughput benchmark is claimed.
